npm manages JS packages; package.json stores scripts, dependencies, devDependencies and metadata.
Install trusted dependencies.
package.json එක project metadata සහ scripts, dependencies වැනි package information තියාගන්නවා.
Install React and a dev-only formatter.
Read the diagram: The manifest declares requested dependencies; the lock records resolved versions.

npm install react
npm install -D prettier
# inspect package.json
Expected result: react is added as a dependency; prettier as a devDependency.

Interview question: dependencies vs devDependencies?
Answer: Runtime/application dependencies versus packages mainly used for development/build/test
tooling.
Practice: Inspect scripts and both dependency sections in your project.
